AzureBlobStorage._comment: Blob endpoint for the 'app-screenshots' container, read by AppScreenshotService when no AzureTableStorage:ConnectionString is set (i.e. the managed-identity path in production). Not a secret — it is the public endpoint of the account, and access is governed by the identity's Storage Blob Data Contributor role. Without it GetContainerAsync returns null and stored screenshots never serve, which looks identical to 'no screenshots were ever captured'. Ignored in Development, where the Azurite connection string takes precedence.

ApplicationInsights._comment: Connection string is supplied at runtime via Key Vault secret 'ApplicationInsights--ConnectionString' or the APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING env var. Do not commit it here.

FeatureFlags._managementComment: On everywhere so the nightly uptime-scan workflow can POST /api/diag/refresh. In Production ManagementActionFilter still demands Security:ManagementApiKey (Key Vault) and /api/config reports false, so no visitor sees a button that would 401.
FeatureFlags._screenshotsComment: In-process capture is off in production: the Windows F1 sandbox cannot run Chromium and the install attempt once filled the worker disk (2026-07-10). .github/workflows/screenshots.yml captures nightly into the same blob container, with the same blob names and viewport, so the two paths are interchangeable; stored images keep serving regardless of this flag. That workflow was referenced here for weeks before it existed, which is why every production card rendered with screenshotUrl: null.
FeatureFlags._autoRefreshComment: When the inventory report is older than 12h, a portfolio page load schedules a background Azure rescan (30-min attempt cooldown). Defaults on outside Development/Testing.
FeatureFlags._aiSummaryComment: Writes the plain-English status paragraph at the top of /azure via Azure AI Foundry (see AzureAi below). Defaults ON — the model runs on the owner's own AI Services account, so there is no free-tier quota to protect. Set false to fall back to the rule-based narrative without removing the integration.

StatusNarrator._comment: Azure AI Foundry chat completions on the shared po-aiservices-shared2 account in the poshared resource group, used for the plain-English status paragraph on /azure. gpt-5.4-nano is the cheapest deployment on that account that writes a coherent paragraph (verified live; the vault's PoPunkouterSoftware--AzureOpenAI--DeploymentName is stale and 404s, so the deployment is NOT read from there).
StatusNarrator._sectionNameComment: Named 'StatusNarrator' and NOT 'AzureAi'/'AzureOpenAI' on purpose. The shared vault is loaded wholesale into configuration and contains estate-wide 'AzureAI--ApiKey'/'AzureAI--Endpoint' secrets pointing at a different account. Configuration keys are case-insensitive, so an 'AzureAi' section silently picked up that foreign key and every call 401'd.
StatusNarrator._authComment: Leave ApiKey empty to use Entra ID via the shared TokenCredential (managed identity in Azure, az login locally), which needs the 'Cognitive Services OpenAI User' role on the account. With no key and no role, the service falls back to the app's own provisioned AzureOpenAI:ApiKey (Key Vault secret 'PoPunkouterSoftware--AzureOpenAI--ApiKey').

SignIns._comment: Cross-estate sign-in roster rendered by /users. Read live from the shared Application Insights component in PoShared (the same records as the 'Po Sign-ins' Azure Monitor workbook): the traces table, where every Po app writes a UserSignedIn record. Not customEvents — the apps export through OpenTelemetry, where custom events are not part of the pipeline.
SignIns._authComment: Queried with the shared TokenCredential (System-Assigned Managed Identity in Azure, az login locally). Needs Monitoring Reader, which the identity already holds at subscription scope from the 2026-09-05 grant. Blank ResourceId, no credential or no role all degrade to an 'unavailable' report on the page, never a 500.
SignIns._windowComment: Default history window in days. Capped at 90 by SignInQueryService.MaxWindowDays because that is the component's retention — a larger number would promise history that does not exist.

Budget._comment: Monthly spend ceiling in USD for the /azure forecast ring. Omit or set 0 to show the projection without a budget comparison — a made-up default would invent a judgement the owner never asked for.

Alerts._comment: Phone push via ntfy (AlertNotifier): a service going down or coming back (ServicePingerService, after 2 consecutive failed probes), a failed Azure scan, and a new spend spike (ReportRefreshRunner). Off while NtfyTopic is blank. On ntfy.sh the topic name IS the credential — anyone who knows it can read the feed — so set it only via the Key Vault secret 'PoPunkouterSoftware--Alerts--NtfyTopic' and subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy phone app. NtfyToken is optional, for a self-hosted server with access control. SiteUrl is where a tapped notification opens (/azure?focus=<service>).

RateLimits._comment: Global fixed-window ceilings on the two anonymous endpoints that spend something per call: /api/signins (live Log Analytics query) and POST /api/diag/ai (paid model completion). Global, not per-IP, on purpose — see Host/RateLimits.cs.

Retention._comment: Age in days before History/HistorySummary table rows are pruned (0 disables). Blob lifecycle (30d) is enforced by infra/main.bicep.

Pinger._comment: Background sweep that warms cold-start instances AND records per-day reachability tallies for the /azure uptime grid (see UptimeSampleStore). Tallies age out on Retention:HistoryDays. Disabling this does not break the grid — it falls back to full-scan observations alone, which only exist on days a scan ran.

Security._comment: Shared key for mutating/expensive endpoints, checked against the X-Management-Key header. REQUIRED in Production whenever FeatureFlags:EnableManagementActions is true — ManagementActionFilter fails closed without it, because the flag alone would leave /api/diag/refresh open to anonymous callers. Supply it via the Key Vault secret 'PoPunkouterSoftware--Security--ManagementApiKey', and give the same value to the MANAGEMENT_API_KEY GitHub secret used by .github/workflows/uptime-scan.yml.
